summary: Possibly John's 4th-great-grand-uncle (or a cousin); husband of Phoebe Davenport.
bio: John Pringle married Phoebe Davenport (1799 - after 1873), daughter of Thomas and Charity (Lamoreaux) Davenport; nine children 1821-36: Thomas, Elizabeth, Clara, Liddie, William, Dennison, Charity D. (m. liveryman Andrew R. Worthington 1855), Stephen, Martha. Phebe Pringle's will: Plymouth, 1867, vol. D p.344. Whether John was Samuel's son or a nephew is speculative.
sources: Giles & Franklin, Thomas Davenport, Philipstown Pioneer 1682-1759, and his Descendants (1962): https://archive.org/details/thomasdavenportp00gile (also HathiTrust wu.89066038563: https://babel.hathitrust.org/cgi/pt?id=wu.89066038563&view=1up&seq=395) pp.321-322
